content.title: About
content.content: Potato, scalloped, NFS (4208) is a ready‑to‑eat product made from selected potatoes sliced thinly and baked in a creamy cheese sauce. It is produced gluten‑free and designed for quick preparation in a microwave or conventional oven.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Scalloped potatoes became popular in the United States in the early 20th century.
NFS stands for "No Further Seasoning" – the product is ready to eat without additional seasoning.
One serving provides about 150 kcal, making it a convenient snack.
Cheddar cheese is commonly used, creating a golden crust when baked.
The product is packaged in a sealed film that preserves freshness for up to 12 months.

items.title: Rich in potassium
items.content: Potatoes are a good source of potassium, which supports normal heart and muscle function.

items.title: Vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C contributes to immune support and protects cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber aids digestion and promotes a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Low sodium
items.content: The product is formulated with minimal added salt, beneficial for blood‑pressure management.

items.title: Quick energy source
items.content: Carbohydrates in potatoes are readily absorbed, providing fast energy.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: The cheese component may trigger reactions in individuals with lactose intolerance or milk allergy.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Potatoes can raise blood‑sugar levels quickly, so people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

items.title: Additive content
items.content: Some versions may contain preservatives; check the label if you are sensitive to food additives.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the product in a microwave (2–3 minutes) or bake in an oven at 180 °C for 12–15 minutes. Serve as a side dish, a standalone meal, or add to salads. Fresh herbs can be sprinkled on top for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, reseal the package tightly. Shelf life shortens at temperatures above 25 °C.
